candidate_program.name: repair_focused_global_exchange
candidate_program.rationale: Uses a root-scale greedy inclusion margin when the closed neighborhood occupies a substantial active-set fraction, and a bounded sparsity correction otherwise. Global structure supplies missing distinctions; the score gate does not save computation, and two residual greedy passes remain costly.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.1 * greedy_exchange / (1 + abs(greedy_exchange))) if remaining_count > 8 * (1 + degree) else greedy_exchange + 0.05 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
